##### Mixed DANGs and SWINGs
######  DANGs
We introduce the causal directed acyclic network graph (DANG). DANGs encode the structure of the causal process within observational units separately from the causal process as it unfolds across them  The former is termed the *structural part* of the DANG and the latter the *relational part*. The structural part is a DAG representing the relationships among random vectors of length equal to the number of units.The DAG has the standard interpretation under [d-separation rules](#sec-d-separation) rules.

{{< include fig-causal-dang-instructions.qmd >}}

For example, above is a DANG of the model we developed for [Example 2](#sec-example-2). The relational part of @fig-causal-dang-instructions shows that *Persons 1* and *2* influence each other. The structural part shows a DAG of random vectors $\mathbf{L}$, $\mathbf{A}$, and $\mathbf{Y}$, each of length 3. It shows the marriage between *Persons 1* and *2* separately from the causal structure linking employment, dress, and job opportunities within each individual.
